name: agent-ops-claude-code-codex
description: Paste-ready review prompts, CLAUDE.md rules, and task briefs for reliable AI coding-agent workflows.

commands.title: Get the Complete Agent Ops Kit

walkthroughs.title: Get Started with Agent Ops
walkthroughs.description: Give Claude Code, Codex, and other coding agents tighter instructions and evidence-driven review gates.

steps.title: Insert an adversarial review prompt
steps.description: Run [Insert Adversarial Review Prompt](command:agentOps.insertReviewPrompt) and choose a focused final gate. Browse the free [AI Code Review Prompts](https://github.com/soul-sol/ai-code-review-prompts) repository.

steps.title: Add an operating rule
steps.description: Run [Insert CLAUDE.md Pattern](command:agentOps.insertClaudeMdPattern) to add one battle-tested rule. Explore [CLAUDE.md Patterns](https://github.com/soul-sol/claude-md-patterns) and [Agent Watch](https://github.com/soul-sol/agent-watch).

steps.title: Brief an agent, then go deeper
steps.description: Run [Insert New Task Brief](command:agentOps.newTaskBrief) for a scoped handoff, or [open the Complete Agent Ops Kit](command:agentOps.getFullKit) for the paid collection.
